  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (new criterion for NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3017-APP-AC7)
    Given the release fake fails an attempt of the requestRelease activity
    When the attempt exceeds the activity timeout
    Then the activity is retried under the retry policy of TreatmentWorkflow
    Then the activity completes once a retry succeeds

  Scenario: AC8 Disallowed transition refused (new criterion for NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3017-APP-AC8)
    Given the case status mock returns a status from which the requested change is not allowed
    When the release branch requests that status change
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
